reviews.title: A consideration to make
reviews.contents: I have used this app a few times it is good but if i can make a suggestion. I have sadly had to opt out from the app 5 times due to reoccurring miscarriages. Each time i have come back the app try’s to go back to my previous pregnancy even tho i have entered into the app that i miscarried. Please consider changing this, my most recent loss has been very painful. However i hope to be back one day and it would be so nice to have a fresh start . Thank you for any consideration.

reviews.title: Great app
reviews.contents: I have used this app for both of my pregnancies and love it. It has a lot of great information you want to know that is quick and easy to find. Highly recommend it !

reviews.title: Loose the Flipping liquor ads!!
reviews.contents: I think it’s pretty offensive to be subjected to a booze advertisement before learning about my baby’s development! That’s gotta change. As an alcoholic with over a decade of sobriety under her belt, the last thing I want to see is an ad for booze while pregnant no less! That has to change!

reviews.title: It says I’m farther along than I am
reviews.contents: I inputed my info for the calculated due date and it says that I’m 2 weeks farther along than I am..I tried changing my calculated date by putting in my conception date rather than my last period but no change. It says that I conceived 20 days earlier than what I put in, and when I try to change it in the settings it won’t save. If the dates were right I would be following the app closer because it has a lot of good information.

reviews.title: Too many ads
reviews.contents: I couldn’t get myself to use this app because of excessive amounts of ads. I saw more ads than relevant information.

reviews.title: Censorship
reviews.contents: Great app unfortunately you can’t be conservative  without getting your comments deleted.

reviews.title: Skinny people used in photos
reviews.contents: Come on guys, this is unacceptable. Please get some reasonable looking women if you’re going to use models - not skinny ladies

reviews.title: Inconsiderate
reviews.contents: Completely inconsiderate if you suffer a miscarriage. They have an option to mark pregnancy loss but still continue to send you emails as if you are still pregnant. Other apps do not do this. Deleted this app and won’t be using it again.

reviews.title: Trolling ruins the space.  Racism is very prevalent.
reviews.contents:
I’ve been using this app for quite a few years now.  It’s been helpful along the way.  I’ve become a part of a community of strong women.

WTE needs to do more about taking care of troll posts... especially those that are racist and violent.  They need to develop policies that block IP addresses so that trolls can’t just make a new account to continue their harassment.

I’ve seen some of the most heinous comments and posts to many of the women of colour on the board.  There should be a policy so strong against the actual death threats I’ve seen that it is rarely, ideally never, seen.  WTE should be protecting their user base and allowing them opportunity to bring legal action against threats and harassment.  

I’m incredibly disappointed that this isn’t a priority.

reviews.title: Awesome app!
reviews.contents: Loooove this app! Great tips everyday, I love the forums where all the moms can exchange about their pregnancy!!
